name: Phinehas (son of Eleazar)
title: The Zealous Priest
summary: Phinehas was the grandson of Aaron and served as a priest in Israel. He is best known for his zealous act when he stopped a plague in Israel at Baal-Peor, and God gave him an everlasting covenant of priesthood as a reward for his faithfulness.

keyEvents.title: Stopped the Plague at Baal-Peor
keyEvents.description: When the Israelites sinned with Moabite women and began to worship Baal-Peor, Phinehas took a spear and killed an Israelite man and a Midianite woman, thereby stopping the plague that had already killed 24,000 people.

keyEvents.title: Received the Eternal Priestly Covenant
keyEvents.description: Because of his zeal for God, Phinehas received an eternal covenant of peace from the Lord, securing the priesthood for his descendants forever.

keyEvents.title: Led the War Against the Midianites
keyEvents.description: Phinehas was sent with a thousand men from each tribe to wage war against Midian as vengeance for the events at Baal-Peor.

keyEvents.title: Sent as an envoy to the tribes east of the Jordan
keyEvents.description: When the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar by the Jordan, Phinehas was sent as leader of a delegation to investigate the matter and prevent conflict.

keyEvents.title: Served at the ark of the covenant
keyEvents.description: Phinehas served as priest at the ark of the covenant in Bethel during the time of the judges and inquired of the Lord on behalf of Israel in the war against Benjamin.
